scope: Local noncommercial research prototype. Licenses differ by resource; source availability is not a redistribution license.

resources.name: VLNVerse door / Eyz, kujiale_0003
resources.license: Dataset license not specified on the inspected distribution page; local preview only pending permission review
resources.use: Actual door_0000 USD, converted with OpenUSD into 38 browser meshes. Original geometry and USD retained. Display materials, width adaptation, hinge control and hand-contact animation are locally authored. This is a door asset import, not an imported VLNVerse house.

resources.name: Microsoft Rocketbox / Female Adult 01 and native motion clips
resources.license: MIT; copyright Microsoft Corporation; upstream LICENSE.md included
resources.use: Realistic civilian character with native f_walk_neutral and f_idle_neutral_01 skeletal clips. Root travel is removed and replaced by the annotated scene path. Three.js CCD inverse kinematics controls the reaching arm during the door event. This is an additional human library, not a VLNVerse, PartNet-Mobility or Infinigen asset.

resources.name: AWS RoboMaker Small House World
resources.use: House geometry, textures and 85 layout objects. Source SDF/DAE and collision geometry retained. Ceilings are hidden only in the overview. Original folding-door meshes are omitted; a VLNVerse door is added to the bedroom opening. No archived simulator dependencies are executed.

resources.name: Tree Small 02 / Rico Cilliers, Poly Haven
resources.use: Textured outdoor trees, locally placed. Browser LOD derived with meshoptimizer; original retained. Not Infinigen output.

resources.name: Rock Moss Set 01 / Kless Gyzen, Poly Haven
resources.use: Textured stream-bank rocks.

resources.name: Painted Wooden Bench / Kirill Sannikov, Poly Haven (unused)
resources.use: Original downloaded files retained but no longer loaded or placed. Replaced by locally authored open-slat park benches with visible seats, backs and metal supports. The park contains no piano or piano sound.

resources.name: Forest Ground 04 / Poly Haven
resources.use: Ground colour texture. Stream, bridge, paths and music-box geometry are authored. The outdoor environment is not a full-scene capture or an Infinigen export.

resources.name: AID music_box_02_RHODE_NT1.wav / Goetz et al.
resources.use: Eight-second anechoic music-box recording, filtered to reduce handling rumble, dynamically balanced and edge-faded for indoor playback from 0 to 32 s. Original and former music_box_01 recording retained. Processing is documented in assets/audio/music-box-metadata.json. No generated tune or pitch shifting. Category-compatible sound for authored geometry, not a recording or acoustic calibration of that exact object.

resources.name: EARS p002_emo_adoration_sentences.wav / Richter et al.
resources.use: Original 48 kHz mono female speech, 9.76475 s. The official speaker_statistics.json identifies p002 as female; both episodes pair it with the female Rocketbox character without pitch shifting. Gender compatibility is not speaker identity matching; no lip sync. The previous male p008 file is retained but is not used.

resources.name: door closed.wav / soundofsong / Freesound 647645
resources.use: A short recorded soft door closure. The public HQ MP3 preview is retained and converted to 48 kHz mono WAV. Its measured peak at 0.0859167 s is aligned with complete door closure at 26.5 s. A category-compatible effect, not an anechoic recording, matched physical door or synthesized material response.

resources.name: Swale.ogg / Siddharth Patil (Ksd5)
resources.use: Existing stream.wav excerpt of a real field recording. Not dry audio. Represented by a single point source; original environmental cues remain.

resources.name: AID foot_steps_04_RHODE_NT1.wav / Goetz et al. (unused)
resources.use: Original recording and former single-hit excerpt retained for provenance only. Neither is used in current playback. Replaced by surface-specific multi-take recordings to avoid repeating one hard impact.

resources.name: Steps on a wooden floor #4 / Joseph Sardin / BigSoundBank 1518
resources.use: Lossless 48 kHz mono 24-bit recording of shoes on wood, recorded outdoors. Eight distinct 0.48 s footfalls drive the indoor visitor's contacts. Mild band filtering and one collection-level gain retain take-to-take differences; no pitch shifting. Category-compatible wood/shoe pairing, not an anechoic or instance-matched floor measurement. Cut points and processing in assets/audio/footsteps/manifest.json.

resources.name: Footsteps_Grass_1.wav / SilentStrikeZ / Freesound 389625
resources.use: Actual grass-walking foley. Public HQ MP3 preview retained; eight different footfalls converted to mono 48 kHz for the outdoor visitor. No artificial pitch changes. Not calibrated to the rendered shoes or exact ground. Only the visible character produces footsteps; the camera/listener does not. Cut points in assets/audio/footsteps/manifest.json.

resources.name: Electric desk fan / TimBahrij / Freesound 191580
resources.use: Public HQ MP3 preview retained; steady 6-15.5 s excerpt looped with a 160 ms crossfade, excluding button clicks. The pedestal fan mesh is authored locally. Activity is shared with the rotor, but timbre and rotational speed are not physically calibrated or instance matched. The recording is not anechoic.

resources.name: pyroomacoustics 0.10.1 / assumed room responses
resources.license: MIT; generated IRs use locally authored room assumptions
resources.use: Image-source shoebox reflections for illustrative bedroom and living-room dimensions. Direct arrival removed, wet IR energy normalized for audition. Fixed stereo reference responses crossfade by listener zone; not responses measured or recomputed from the detailed house mesh at each pose. Full parameters in assets/audio/acoustics-metadata.json.

resources.name: Poly Haven visual lighting and material upgrade
resources.license: CC0; individual source links and checksums in assets/rendering/SOURCES.json
resources.use: Lebombo indoor image-based lighting; Kloppenheim 06 pure-sky environment; Wood Floor Deck PBR maps for authored wood surfaces; Leafy Grass ground maps; Grass Medium 02 bank vegetation; original Tree Small 02 leaf alpha. Powered by Poly Haven. These improve appearance but do not supply measured material acoustics or a reconstructed real-world scene.

resources.name: German Shepard / Quaternius, via Poly Pizza
resources.license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 as listed by Poly Pizza; attribution and license link retained in assets/living/DOG-CREDITS.txt
resources.use: German shepherd with native Idle and Walk clips. Root travel is removed; route placement and the alert-head motion during barking are locally authored. No retargeting from a fox rig, native bark clip or jaw synchronization is claimed. This is a game asset, not a photorealistic scan. The perched blackbird-like model and vacuum geometry are authored locally. Hashes and limitations are in assets/living/manifest.json.

resources.name: Old dog barking 2 / Joseph Sardin / BigSoundBank 2353
resources.use: One 0.55 s bark from the original WAV, with mild highpass, gain reduction and edge fades. Shared by indoor and outdoor dog variants. Bark events occur during planned pauses; no artificial dog footsteps are added. Not an anechoic or instance-matched recording.

resources.name: Common Blackbird 20 / Le tiroir du fond / BigSoundBank 3493
resources.use: A mono 3.2 s recorded phrase, spatialized at the perched bird. This is a category-compatible virtual pairing, not a species or beak-motion calibration. Original recording retained; no generic multi-bird ambience is attributed to a single bird.

resources.name: Robot vacuum / Joseph Sardin / BigSoundBank 1623
resources.use: Steady 30-42 s portion of an actual Roomba recording, crossfaded into a loop. Paired with an authored generic vacuum model. Shared operating state gates audio and motor visuals; wheels follow route distance. Not a measured instance, RPM, suction or navigation model.

resources.name: Dog Steps.wav / Angellu16 / Freesound 533824
resources.use: Public HQ preview cut into eight short, quiet indoor paw taps. Not human shoes. The source does not document floor material; wood-floor pairing is illustrative, not measured. Processing and source excerpts are recorded in assets/living/paws/manifest.json.

resources.name: Dog running / congusbongus; Wolf run.wav / sabotovat
resources.license: CC BY 3.0; credits retained in assets/living/paws/CREDITS.txt
resources.use: Eight soft-ground canine foley excerpts, reduced in gain and shortened for the walking dog. Original source: https://freesound.org/people/sabotovat/sounds/414350/. No human footstep bank is reused. Native paw-height phases estimate contacts; these are not force-based contacts, exact grass materials or body-size calibrated recordings.

resources.name: Three.js r180
resources.use: WebGL rendering, GLTF/Collada/FBX/TGA loading, skeletal cloning, CCDIKSolver, HDR loading, indoor SSAO and FXAA/output passes. Water uses the repository's reflective-water example and water-normal texture; it is a visual effect, not a fluid simulation.
